§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 real estate vocabulary to advanced C1 investment and development discourse, every module is anchored in real-world property scenarios — from residential sales to commercial leasing, from mortgage financing to urban development. Built for use inside brokerages, developers, property management firms, and real estate investment trusts.

Brice Gadou

Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. Flats reflects his vision: language learning as property capability — a multiplier of careers, portfolios, and place.

Designed for the brokers, developers, and investment leaders shaping global real estate — Flats is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to close in one of the most enduring industries of our time.
